{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Fire Rooster|kanji=丁酉|romaji=hinoto tori|onyomi=teiyū|p=dīyǒu|w=ting-yu|mi=tʰiŋ⁵³ i̯ɤʊ̯²¹|y=deng1 jau5|j=deng1 jau5|ci=tɛŋ jɐu|mc=tæŋ jɨu|oc-bs=tæŋ jɯʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Fire Rooster''' (丁酉, ''hinoto tori''; onyomi ''teiyū'') is the 34th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 34th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Fire Monkey|ja|丙申|1=Yang Fire Monkey}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Earth Dog|ja|戊戌|1=Yang Earth Dog}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''丁'' is Yin Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''酉'' (Rooster) is Yin Metal; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Fire Rooster (丁酉)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): dīngyǒu
** Cantonese (Jyutping): ding1 jau5
** Japanese:
***Kunyomi 1: Hinoto-tori
***Kunyomi 2: Teika-no-tori
***Onyomi 1: teiyū
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): jeongyu (정유)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Đinh Dậu

=== Events ===
* In {{ill|Keichō|en|Keichō|qid=Q1328185|lt=Keichō|1=Keichō}} 2 (1597 AD), the campaign known as the {{ill|Keichō Campaign|ja|文禄・慶長の役#慶長の役|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keichō Campaign|1=Imjin War|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q576338}} took place, which in Korea is referred to as the "Teiyuu Rebellion."
* In {{ill|Tenmon|ja|天文|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenmon}} 6 (1537 AD), the temple founded in Tsushima by {{ill|Kagetetsu Gensu|ja|景轍玄蘇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kagetetsu Gensu|1=Keitetsu Genso|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10855181}} was named "Itou" (酊) by combining the characters of Teiyuu.

==Months of Yin Fire Rooster==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Sin|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sin}} and {{ill|Bing|ja|丙|1=Hinoe (丙)|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bing}}), the month of {{ill|August|en|August|qid=Q122|lt=August|1=August}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)|1=Month}} of {{ill|Teiyuu|ja|丁酉|1=Yin Fire Rooster|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Teiyuu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=White Dew|1=Bailu (solar term)}} until the day before {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Cold Dew|1=Hanlu}}) as applicable.
